<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sp_widget"><sp_widget action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><category>custom</category><client_script><![CDATA[api.controller=function() {
  /* widget controller */
  var c = this;
};]]></client_script><controller_as>c</controller_as><css>.analytics-page {
    max-width: 1080px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 28px;
    color: #102a56;
}


/* =========================================
   HEADER
========================================= */

.analytics-header {

    background: linear-gradient(
        135deg,
        #f4f3ff,
        #eef1ff
    );

    border: 1px solid #dfe3ff;
    border-radius: 18px;

    padding: 30px;

    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;

    margin-bottom: 22px;
}


.eyebrow {

    font-size: 11px;

    letter-spacing: 2px;

    font-weight: 700;

    color: #5267e8;
}


.analytics-header h1 {

    margin: 8px 0 5px;

    font-size: 28px;

    color: #082b62;
}


.analytics-header p {

    margin: 0 0 12px;

    color: #66789b;
}


.company-label {

    display: inline-block;

    padding: 6px 10px;

    border-radius: 7px;

    background: #eef1ff;

    color: #5267e8;

    font-size: 12px;

    font-weight: 600;
}


/* =========================================
   BUTTON
========================================= */

.btn {

    display: inline-block;

    padding: 11px 18px;

    border-radius: 9px;

    text-decoration: none;

    font-size: 13px;

    font-weight: 600;
}


.btn-secondary {

    border: 1px solid #cbd5ef;

    background: white;

    color: #3156e8;
}


/* =========================================
   KPI GRID
========================================= */

.kpi-grid {

    display: grid;

    grid-template-columns:
        repeat(4, 1fr);

    gap: 14px;

    margin-bottom: 20px;
}


.kpi-card {

    background: white;

    border: 1px solid #dce3f0;

    border-radius: 14px;

    padding: 20px;

    display: flex;

    align-items: center;

    gap: 14px;

    box-shadow:
        0 5px 18px
        rgba(40, 65, 110, 0.05);
}


.kpi-icon {

    width: 42px;

    height: 42px;

    border-radius: 11px;

    display: flex;

    align-items: center;

    justify-content: center;

    font-size: 18px;

    font-weight: 700;
}


.kpi-icon.purple {

    background: #eef0ff;

    color: #5267e8;
}


.kpi-icon.blue {

    background: #edf5ff;

    color: #2875d6;
}


.kpi-icon.green {

    background: #eaf8f0;

    color: #16834a;
}


.kpi-icon.orange {

    background: #fff6e5;

    color: #d88900;
}


.kpi-label {

    font-size: 11px;

    color: #7a89a5;

    margin-bottom: 5px;
}


.kpi-value {

    font-size: 24px;

    font-weight: 700;

    color: #102e61;
}


/* =========================================
   ANALYTICS GRID
========================================= */

.analytics-grid {

    display: grid;

    grid-template-columns:
        repeat(2, 1fr);

    gap: 18px;

    margin-bottom: 18px;
}


.analytics-card {

    background: white;

    border: 1px solid #dce3f0;

    border-radius: 16px;

    padding: 24px;

    box-shadow:
        0 6px 20px
        rgba(40, 65, 110, 0.05);

    margin-bottom: 18px;
}


.card-header {

    margin-bottom: 22px;
}


.card-header h2 {

    margin: 0 0 5px;

    color: #173b70;

    font-size: 17px;
}


.card-header p {

    margin: 0;

    color: #8290aa;

    font-size: 12px;
}


/* =========================================
   STATUS / LOCATION
========================================= */

.status-row,
.location-row {

    margin-bottom: 18px;
}


.status-info,
.location-name {

    display: flex;

    justify-content: space-between;

    align-items: center;

    margin-bottom: 7px;

    font-size: 13px;

    color: #42577a;
}


.status-info strong,
.location-name strong {

    color: #173b70;
}


.progress {

    height: 7px;

    background: #edf0f7;

    border-radius: 10px;

    overflow: hidden;
}


.progress-bar {

    height: 100%;

    background: #5267e8;

    border-radius: 10px;

    transition:
        width 0.3s ease;
}


.location-bar {

    background: #2875d6;
}


/* =========================================
   PIPELINE
========================================= */

.pipeline-card {

    margin-bottom: 18px;
}


.pipeline {

    display: flex;

    align-items: center;

    justify-content: space-between;

    gap: 8px;

    overflow-x: auto;

    padding: 5px 0;
}


.pipeline-step {

    min-width: 105px;

    text-align: center;
}


.pipeline-number {

    width: 54px;

    height: 54px;

    margin: 0 auto 8px;

    border-radius: 50%;

    background: #eef1ff;

    color: #5267e8;

    display: flex;

    align-items: center;

    justify-content: center;

    font-size: 17px;

    font-weight: 700;
}


.pipeline-label {

    font-size: 11px;

    color: #647694;

    white-space: nowrap;
}


.pipeline-arrow {

    color: #a3aec3;

    font-size: 18px;

    flex-shrink: 0;
}


/* =========================================
   OUTCOME
========================================= */

.outcome-grid {

    display: grid;

    grid-template-columns:
        repeat(3, 1fr);

    gap: 14px;
}


.outcome-item {

    background: #f8f9ff;

    border: 1px solid #e4e8f8;

    border-radius: 12px;

    padding: 18px;

    display: flex;

    align-items: center;

    gap: 14px;
}


.outcome-icon {

    width: 40px;

    height: 40px;

    border-radius: 10px;

    background: #eaf8f0;

    color: #16834a;

    display: flex;

    align-items: center;

    justify-content: center;

    font-weight: 700;
}


.outcome-item span {

    display: block;

    font-size: 11px;

    color: #7b89a3;

    margin-bottom: 4px;
}


.outcome-item strong {

    font-size: 20px;

    color: #173b70;
}


/* =========================================
   EMPTY STATE
========================================= */

.empty-state {

    padding: 25px;

    text-align: center;

    color: #8793a8;

    font-size: 13px;
}


/* =========================================
   ERROR
========================================= */

.error-message {

    padding: 18px;

    background: #fff2f2;

    border: 1px solid #ffd2d2;

    border-radius: 10px;

    color: #c62828;

    margin-bottom: 20px;
}


/* =========================================
   FOOTER
========================================= */

.analytics-footer {

    text-align: center;

    color: #8995aa;

    font-size: 12px;

    padding: 10px;
}


/* =========================================
   RESPONSIVE
========================================= */

@media (max-width: 900px) {

    .kpi-grid {

        grid-template-columns:
            repeat(2, 1fr);

    }

}


@media (max-width: 700px) {

    .analytics-header {

        flex-direction: column;

        align-items: flex-start;

        gap: 20px;

    }


    .analytics-grid {

        grid-template-columns: 1fr;

    }


    .kpi-grid {

        grid-template-columns: 1fr;

    }


    .outcome-grid {

        grid-template-columns: 1fr;

    }

}</css><data_table>sp_instance</data_table><demo_data/><description/><docs/><field_list/><has_preview>false</has_preview><id>campus360_recruiter_analytics</id><internal>false</internal><link><![CDATA[function link(scope, element, attrs, controller) {
  
}]]></link><name>Recruiter Analytics</name><option_schema/><public>false</public><roles/><script><![CDATA[(function() {

    // =====================================================
    // CURRENT TEST RECRUITER
    // =====================================================

    // We are intentionally using the same sample recruiter
    // until the complete recruiter portal is finished.

    data.recruiter_name = 'Ananya Mehta';
    data.recruiter_id = 'RCR001';


    // =====================================================
    // CURRENT TEST COMPANY
    // =====================================================

    // TechNova Solutions - CMP001

    var companySysId =
        'e9268662acd303107f44b432e349694b';


    // =====================================================
    // INITIAL DATA
    // =====================================================

    data.error = '';

    data.company = {
        name: 'TechNova Solutions',
        id: 'CMP001'
    };


    data.kpi = {

        total_opportunities: 0,
        active_opportunities: 0,

        total_applications: 0,
        shortlisted: 0,

        total_interviews: 0,
        selected: 0,

        offers: 0,
        placements: 0

    };


    data.application_status = [];

    data.locations = [];

    data.pipeline = {

        applications: 0,
        shortlisted: 0,
        interviews: 0,
        selected: 0,
        offers: 0,
        placements: 0

    };


    data.outcomes = {

        selected: 0,
        on_campus: 0,
        off_campus: 0

    };


    // =====================================================
    // GET COMPANY
    // =====================================================

    var companyGR =
        new GlideRecord(
            'x_snc_campus360_company_master'
        );


    if (!companyGR.get(companySysId)) {

        data.error =
            'Company record could not be found.';

        return;

    }


    data.company.name =
        companyGR.getValue('company_name');

    data.company.id =
        companyGR.getValue('company_id');


    // =====================================================
    // 1. PLACEMENT OPPORTUNITIES
    // =====================================================

    var oppGR =
        new GlideRecord(
            'x_snc_campus360_placement_opportunity'
        );


    oppGR.addQuery(
        'company',
        companySysId
    );

    oppGR.query();


    var opportunityIds = [];

    var locationMap = {};

    while (oppGR.next()) {

        data.kpi.total_opportunities++;

        opportunityIds.push(
            oppGR.getUniqueValue()
        );


        // ---------------------------------------------
        // ACTIVE / OPEN OPPORTUNITIES
        // ---------------------------------------------

        var oppStatus =
            oppGR.getValue('status');


        if (
            oppStatus == 'Open' ||
            oppStatus == 'open'
        ) {

            data.kpi.active_opportunities++;

        }


        // ---------------------------------------------
        // LOCATION ANALYTICS
        // ---------------------------------------------

        var location =
            oppGR.getValue('location');


        if (location) {

            if (!locationMap[location]) {

                locationMap[location] = 0;

            }

            locationMap[location]++;

        }

    }


    // =====================================================
    // CONVERT LOCATION MAP TO ARRAY
    // =====================================================

    for (var locationName in locationMap) {

        data.locations.push({

            name: locationName,

            count:
                locationMap[locationName]

        });

    }


    // =====================================================
    // 2. STUDENT APPLICATIONS
    // =====================================================

    if (opportunityIds.length > 0) {

        var appGR =
            new GlideRecord(
                'x_snc_campus360_student_application'
            );


        appGR.addQuery(
            'opportunity',
            'IN',
            opportunityIds.join(',')
        );

        appGR.query();


        var applicationStatusMap = {};


        while (appGR.next()) {

            data.kpi.total_applications++;

            data.pipeline.applications++;


            // -----------------------------------------
            // APPLICATION STATUS
            // -----------------------------------------

            var applicationStatus =
                appGR.getDisplayValue(
                    'application_status'
                );


            if (!applicationStatus) {

                applicationStatus = 'Unknown';

            }


            if (
                !applicationStatusMap[
                    applicationStatus
                ]
            ) {

                applicationStatusMap[
                    applicationStatus
                ] = 0;

            }


            applicationStatusMap[
                applicationStatus
            ]++;


            // -----------------------------------------
            // SHORTLISTED
            // -----------------------------------------

            var shortlisted =
                appGR.getValue(
                    'shortlisted'
                );


            if (
                shortlisted == 'true' ||
                shortlisted == '1'
            ) {

                data.kpi.shortlisted++;

                data.pipeline.shortlisted++;

            }


            // -----------------------------------------
            // OFFER STATUS
            // -----------------------------------------

            var offerStatus =
                appGR.getDisplayValue(
                    'offer_status'
                );


            if (
                offerStatus == 'Offered' ||
                offerStatus == 'offered'
            ) {

                data.kpi.offers++;

                data.pipeline.offers++;

            }

        }


        // =================================================
        // APPLICATION STATUS ARRAY
        // =================================================

        for (
            var statusName in applicationStatusMap
        ) {

            data.application_status.push({

                name: statusName,

                count:
                    applicationStatusMap[
                        statusName
                    ]

            });

        }

    }


    // =====================================================
    // 3. RECRUITER INTERVIEWS
    // =====================================================

    var interviewGR =
        new GlideRecord(
            'x_snc_campus360_recruiter_interview'
        );


    interviewGR.addQuery(
        'company',
        companySysId
    );

    interviewGR.query();


    while (interviewGR.next()) {

        data.kpi.total_interviews++;

        data.pipeline.interviews++;


        // ---------------------------------------------
        // RESULT = SELECTED
        // ---------------------------------------------

        var interviewResult =
            interviewGR.getDisplayValue(
                'result'
            );


        if (
            interviewResult == 'Selected' ||
            interviewResult == 'selected'
        ) {

            data.kpi.selected++;

            data.pipeline.selected++;

        }

    }


    // =====================================================
    // 4. PLACEMENT OUTCOMES
    // =====================================================

    var outcomeGR =
        new GlideRecord(
            'x_snc_campus360_placement_outcome'
        );


    outcomeGR.addQuery(
        'company',
        companySysId
    );

    outcomeGR.query();


    while (outcomeGR.next()) {

        data.kpi.placements++;

        data.pipeline.placements++;


        // ---------------------------------------------
        // OUTCOME TYPE
        // ---------------------------------------------

        var outcomeType =
            outcomeGR.getDisplayValue(
                'outcome_type'
            );


        if (
            outcomeType == 'Selected' ||
            outcomeType == 'selected'
        ) {

            data.outcomes.selected++;

        }


        // ---------------------------------------------
        // PLACEMENT TYPE
        // ---------------------------------------------

        var placementType =
            outcomeGR.getDisplayValue(
                'placement_type'
            );


        if (
            placementType == 'On Campus' ||
            placementType == 'On campus'
        ) {

            data.outcomes.on_campus++;

        }


        if (
            placementType == 'Off Campus' ||
            placementType == 'Off campus'
        ) {

            data.outcomes.off_campus++;

        }

    }


})();]]></script><servicenow>false</servicenow><sys_class_name>sp_widget</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-29 17:41:39</sys_created_on><sys_id>0c88dfbe086703107f44368bf163ed3a</sys_id><sys_mod_count>1</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Recruiter Analytics</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Campus360" source="x_snc_campus360">7cd68adee41703107f44d305db800ec3</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Campus360">7cd68adee41703107f44d305db800ec3</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sp_widget_0c88dfbe086703107f44368bf163ed3a</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-29 17:48:20</sys_updated_on><template><![CDATA[<div class="analytics-page">

  <!-- =========================================
       HEADER
  ========================================== -->

  <div class="analytics-header">

    <div>

      <span class="eyebrow">
        COMPANY ANALYTICS
      </span>

      <h1>
        Recruitment Analytics
      </h1>

      <p>
        Placement and recruitment insights for
        {{c.data.company_name}}.
      </p>

      <div class="company-info">
        {{c.data.company_name}}
        ·
        {{c.data.company_id}}
      </div>

    </div>

    <div>

      <a
        class="btn btn-secondary"
        href="?id=campus360_recruiter_dashboard_new">

        ← Dashboard

      </a>

    </div>

  </div>


  <!-- =========================================
       ERROR
  ========================================== -->

  <div
    class="error-message"
    ng-if="c.data.error">

    {{c.data.error}}

  </div>


  <!-- =========================================
       KPI CARDS
  ========================================== -->

  <div class="stats-grid">


    <!-- OPPORTUNITIES -->

    <div class="stat-card">

      <div class="stat-icon">
        ▣
      </div>

      <div>

        <div class="stat-label">
          Opportunities
        </div>

        <div class="stat-value">
          {{c.data.stats.opportunities}}
        </div>

      </div>

    </div>


    <!-- APPLICATIONS -->

    <div class="stat-card">

      <div class="stat-icon applications">
        ♙
      </div>

      <div>

        <div class="stat-label">
          Applications
        </div>

        <div class="stat-value">
          {{c.data.stats.applications}}
        </div>

      </div>

    </div>


    <!-- INTERVIEWS -->

    <div class="stat-card">

      <div class="stat-icon interviews">
        ◎
      </div>

      <div>

        <div class="stat-label">
          Interviews
        </div>

        <div class="stat-value">
          {{c.data.stats.interviews}}
        </div>

      </div>

    </div>


    <!-- OFFERS -->

    <div class="stat-card">

      <div class="stat-icon offers">
        ★
      </div>

      <div>

        <div class="stat-label">
          Offers
        </div>

        <div class="stat-value">
          {{c.data.stats.offers}}
        </div>

      </div>

    </div>


    <!-- SELECTED -->

    <div class="stat-card">

      <div class="stat-icon selected">
        ✓
      </div>

      <div>

        <div class="stat-label">
          Selected
        </div>

        <div class="stat-value">
          {{c.data.stats.selected}}
        </div>

      </div>

    </div>

  </div>


  <!-- =========================================
       APPLICATION STATUS
  ========================================== -->

  <div class="analytics-grid">


    <div class="analytics-card">

      <div class="card-header">

        <div>

          <h2>
            Application Status
          </h2>

          <p>
            Current application distribution
          </p>

        </div>

      </div>


      <div class="status-list">

        <div
          class="status-row"
          ng-repeat="item in c.data.application_status">

          <div class="status-name">

            <span class="status-dot"></span>

            {{item.status}}

          </div>

          <div class="status-count">

            {{item.count}}

          </div>

        </div>

      </div>

    </div>


    <!-- =======================================
         INTERVIEW RESULTS
    ======================================== -->

    <div class="analytics-card">

      <div class="card-header">

        <div>

          <h2>
            Interview Results
          </h2>

          <p>
            Candidate interview outcomes
          </p>

        </div>

      </div>


      <div class="status-list">

        <div
          class="status-row"
          ng-repeat="item in c.data.interview_results">

          <div class="status-name">

            <span class="status-dot interview-dot"></span>

            {{item.result}}

          </div>

          <div class="status-count">

            {{item.count}}

          </div>

        </div>

      </div>

    </div>

  </div>


  <!-- =========================================
       OPPORTUNITY APPLICATIONS
  ========================================== -->

  <div class="analytics-card full-card">

    <div class="card-header">

      <div>

        <h2>
          Applications by Opportunity
        </h2>

        <p>
          Number of students applying to each opportunity
        </p>

      </div>

    </div>


    <div
      class="opportunity-list"
      ng-if="c.data.opportunity_applications.length">


      <div
        class="opportunity-row"
        ng-repeat="item in c.data.opportunity_applications">

        <div class="opportunity-name">

          {{item.opportunity}}

        </div>


        <div class="opportunity-bar-container">

          <div
            class="opportunity-bar"
            ng-style="{
              width:
              ((item.count /
              c.data.stats.applications) * 100) + '%'
            }">

          </div>

        </div>


        <div class="opportunity-count">

          {{item.count}}

        </div>

      </div>

    </div>


    <div
      class="empty-message"
      ng-if="!c.data.opportunity_applications.length">

      No applications found.

    </div>

  </div>


  <!-- =========================================
       OFFER SUMMARY
  ========================================== -->

  <div class="analytics-grid">


    <div class="analytics-card">

      <div class="card-header">

        <div>

          <h2>
            Offer Distribution
          </h2>

          <p>
            Placement source of offered candidates
          </p>

        </div>

      </div>


      <div class="offer-grid">

        <div
          class="offer-box"
          ng-repeat="item in c.data.offer_summary">

          <div class="offer-number">
            {{item.count}}
          </div>

          <div class="offer-label">
            {{item.type}}
          </div>

        </div>

      </div>

    </div>


    <!-- =======================================
         PLACEMENT SUMMARY
    ======================================== -->

    <div class="analytics-card">

      <div class="card-header">

        <div>

          <h2>
            Placement Summary
          </h2>

          <p>
            Current placement pipeline
          </p>

        </div>

      </div>


      <div class="funnel">


        <div class="funnel-row">

          <span>
            Applications
          </span>

          <strong>
            {{c.data.stats.applications}}
          </strong>

        </div>


        <div class="funnel-line"></div>


        <div class="funnel-row">

          <span>
            Interviews
          </span>

          <strong>
            {{c.data.stats.interviews}}
          </strong>

        </div>


        <div class="funnel-line"></div>


        <div class="funnel-row">

          <span>
            Selected
          </span>

          <strong>
            {{c.data.stats.selected}}
          </strong>

        </div>


        <div class="funnel-line"></div>


        <div class="funnel-row final">

          <span>
            Offers
          </span>

          <strong>
            {{c.data.stats.offers}}
          </strong>

        </div>

      </div>

    </div>

  </div>


  <!-- =========================================
       PLACEMENT OUTCOMES
  ========================================== -->

  <div class="analytics-card full-card">

    <div class="card-header">

      <div>

        <h2>
          Placement Outcomes
        </h2>

        <p>
          Students who reached the placement outcome stage
        </p>

      </div>

      <div class="record-count">

        {{c.data.outcomes.length}}
        records

      </div>

    </div>


    <div
      class="table-wrapper"
      ng-if="c.data.outcomes.length">


      <table class="outcome-table">

        <thead>

          <tr>

            <th>
              Student
            </th>

            <th>
              Opportunity
            </th>

            <th>
              Outcome
            </th>

            <th>
              Placement Type
            </th>

            <th>
              CTC
            </th>

            <th>
              Joining Date
            </th>

            <th>
              Verification
            </th>

          </tr>

        </thead>


        <tbody>

          <tr
            ng-repeat="outcome in c.data.outcomes">

            <td>
              {{outcome.student || '—'}}
            </td>

            <td>
              {{outcome.opportunity || '—'}}
            </td>

            <td>

              <span class="outcome-badge">
                {{outcome.outcome_type || '—'}}
              </span>

            </td>

            <td>
              {{outcome.placement_type || '—'}}
            </td>

            <td>
              {{outcome.ctc || '—'}}
            </td>

            <td>
              {{outcome.joining_date || '—'}}
            </td>

            <td>
              {{outcome.verification_status || '—'}}
            </td>

          </tr>

        </tbody>

      </table>

    </div>


    <div
      class="empty-message"
      ng-if="!c.data.outcomes.length">

      No placement outcomes available.

    </div>

  </div>

</div>]]></template></sp_widget></record_update>
